class TestValueErrorOnNonStrElements(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_int_element(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe.dedupe(["ok", 42])

    def test_float_element(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe.dedupe(["ok", 1.5])

    def test_none_element(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe.dedupe([None])

    def test_bool_element(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe.dedupe([True])

    def test_list_element(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe.dedupe(["ok", ["nested"]])

    def test_dict_element(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dedupe.dedupe([{"a": "b"}])

            dedupe.dedupe(["a", 1])
